The orb is the moving head. Every trail element stays behind it along recorded history; older sections progressively soften, shrink, thin, and fade.
Tier sets hue. Trail preset sets shape/material. Age sets opacity and detail. These are cosmetic only and never alter liquidity data or calculations.
